The '''TJ-262 security spike''' was a type of [[security spike]] that [[Cipher Nine]] used to deploy a computer virus into the security droids of the [[Maximum Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] in an effort to distract [[SCORPIO]].
